title: Course Outline
summary: Self Development training covering teachability, growth mindset, problem-solving, age-neutral respect, professional team identity, scarcity thinking, appearance, accountability, and healthy communication.

sections.title: About This Course
paragraphs: The Self Development course is for every Zura Spa therapist who wants to grow as a person, not only as a pair of hands.

Technical skill without character still damages the client experience. This course trains the inner habits that show up as professionalism: how you think, how you receive correction, how you respond to lack or another person's success, and how you treat people when nobody is scoring your technique.
Each module has a clear learning outcome. Study the linked handbook article, then practise the mindset on the floor.

sections.title: Course Objective
paragraphs: By completing this course, therapists should be able to:
list: Stay teachable and treat correction as information, not insult.
Respond to problems with calm action instead of blame or panic.
Treat colleagues by role and standard, not by age.
Keep work as a professional team — not friendship or family politics.
Refuse a scarcity identity: do not let lack, envy or need lower the service.
Hold appearance, accountability and communication as part of self-respect.
Notice unhelpful midsts quickly and correct them.

sections.title: Module 1 — Growth Mindset
list: Skills can be developed through practice, feedback and repetition.
Correction is not a personal attack.
Listen → Understand → Practise → Correct → Improve.
Experience without learning is not growth.
Sharing knowledge without becoming superior.
sections.closing: Learning Outcome: The therapist remains teachable and treats improvement as a professional duty.

sections.title: Module 2 — Problem-Solving Mindset
list: Stay calm and check facts before blame.
Act within authority; communicate; escalate when needed.
Protect the client experience while the problem is handled.
Notice → Pause → Understand → Prioritize → Act → Communicate → Escalate → Resolve → Learn.
sections.closing: Learning Outcome: The therapist can respond to floor problems without gossip, hiding issues, or acting outside authority.

sections.title: Module 3 — The Everyone Is 20 Years Old Standard
list: Age must not decide respect, voice, leadership or correction.
Remove age from the equation and see role, responsibility and competence.
Do not refuse correction because someone is younger or older.
Dignity is consistent — not a reward for tenure.

links.label: Read The Everyone is 20 years old standard

sections.closing: Learning Outcome: The therapist addresses colleagues by professional standard, not by who is older.

sections.title: Module 4 — We Are Not Friends, We Are Not Family
list: Personal closeness must never outrank the client, the team or the standard.
Friendship is not permission for disrespect or covering up.
Work is a professional team with duties, fairness and accountability.
Support without unhealthy dependence.

links.label: Read We Are Not Friends, We Are Not Family Standard

sections.closing: Learning Outcome: The therapist can be warm at work without turning the spa into a private clique or family drama.

sections.title: Module 5 — Poverty Mindset and Scarcity
list: Lack is a condition. Scarcity can become a mindset. Neither is your identity.
How to respond if a client says “poverty mindset” — random, directed at an error, or harsh judgment.
Jealousy, envy, badmouthing success, and need-driven service.
Responsible resource use is not poverty. Waste is not abundance.
Notice → Question → Correct → Learn → Improve → Serve professionally.
sections.closing: Learning Outcome: The therapist does not identify with poverty, does not reflect scarcity in service, and drops associated midsts as soon as they notice them.

sections.title: Module 6 — Appearance as Self-Respect
list: Appearance is part of the service, not vanity.
Uniform, hygiene, breath, hands, nails, footwear.
Client-ready before the first client, not only when management is watching.
Accepting appearance correction immediately.
sections.closing: Learning Outcome: The therapist treats grooming as professional self-respect and part of client confidence.

sections.title: Module 7 — Accountability and Self-Management
list: Own assigned work, reports and updates.
Do not leave your responsibility for someone else to remember.
Mistakes plus correction equal growth; hiding issues equals concern.
Personal need does not decide how you treat a client.
sections.closing: Learning Outcome: The therapist can account for their work and does not use personal pressure as an excuse for a lower standard.

sections.title: Module 8 — Communication, Confrontation and Discussion
list: Speak so the client experience stays protected.
Address issues directly without humiliation.
Keep work discussions factual; keep personal conflict off the floor.
Escalate when safety, dignity or standards are at risk.
sections.closing: Learning Outcome: The therapist can raise and receive hard topics professionally, without gossip or public training arguments.

sections.title: Module 9 — Teachability: The Willingness to Learn
list: Teachability as a life skill — leadership is only one application.
How we respond when we discover that we don't know.
Saying “I don't know” and “Let me find out.”
Ego that protects ignorance.
Think, reflect, and search — including information that challenges you.
Discernment: listen, investigate, decide, apply.
Willingness to change your mind.
Knowledge becoming action.
Permission to be a beginner.
The danger of “I already know.”
ADMIT → THINK → SEARCH → PROCESS → ACT → REFLECT.

links.label: Read Teachability: The Willingness to Learn

sections.closing: Learning Outcome: The therapist can admit knowledge gaps honestly, learn without swallowing everything uncritically, apply what they learn, and keep the cycle going.

sections.title: How to Use This Course
paragraphs: Read each module with the linked standard or issue.
After a session, ask: Which mindset showed up — growth, scarcity, envy, blame, or professionalism?
Practise one correction at a time. Self development is repetition, not a single motivational talk.
Revisit modules whenever a floor situation exposes an old habit.

sections.title: The Self Development Standard
paragraphs: NOTICE → QUESTION → CORRECT → LEARN → IMPROVE → SERVE.
Technical skill without character is incomplete. Character without skill is incomplete. Zura Spa requires both.

remember: Self development is noticing unhelpful thinking quickly and choosing the Zura standard instead — with clients, colleagues and yourself.
